posts.content_md:
I'm trying to make wideband transmission gratings in DCG.

The specifications are: ~2200 lines/mm, 4% efficiency over internal angles(i.e. inside glass) from 49 to 73 degrees at 532nm.

My modelling shows that it can be done if the DCG layer is 300nm thick and has a *delta n* of 0.1

I plan to make the grating on DCG layers 5 micrometers thick, and use processing techniques which cause huge gradients in the refractive index thru the depth of the emulsion.

My question is: am I whistling in the wind? If not, can anyone advise on processing schedules which might bring about this grating?
